jobs.title: Customer Service Manager
jobs.description: Omaze is reinventing fundraising by offering people the chance to win once-in-a-lifetime prizes while raising millions for charities around the world. Since launching in the UK in 2020, we've become one of the fastest-growing companies in the country and now, we’re scaling our impact across Europe. We launched in Germany in June 2025 with ambitious growth goals and a clear mission: raise significant funds for local charities while delivering unforgettable experiences to our customers. In the UK alone, we've raised over £150 million for charity, and created over 40 new millionaires. Now, we’re building a standout team in Germany – and we need your help to do it. Learn more at omaze.de . 🔑 About The Job As our Customer Service Manager, you’ll play a key role in delivering a seamless, high-quality customer experience across every interaction. You’ll own and steer our customer experience activities in Germany, while overseeing a larger outsourced support function, ensuring we consistently meet performance targets across email, voice and live chat. Working closely with senior leadership, you’ll contribute to shaping and refining our customer experience strategy, while taking ownership of its day-to-day execution and continuous optimisation in the German market. You’ll be responsible for building scalable processes, improving tools and documentation, employing technology and enabling the team to respond efficiently as demand grows. Acting as the voice of the customer, you’ll surface insights, identify trends and work cross-functionally to improve the overall customer journey. 🔧 What You’ll Be Doing Vendor Relationship & Governance: Building and nurturing a strong, collaborative partnership with our outsourced support provider to ensure high-performance execution across the German market. Cross-Functional Alignment: Serving as the key liaison between the outsourced team and internal Omaze functions (Product, Marketing, Delivery, Legal) to align on upcoming German campaigns, product updates, and customer feedback. Service Level & Performance Oversight: Driving daily, weekly, and monthly performance reviews with vendor leadership to ensure email, voice, and live chat SLAs, CSAT, and FTR targets are consistently met for German customers. Voice of the German Customer: Gathering local customer insights, market-specific nuances, and recurring trends to advocate for improvements directly with cross-functional business partners. Escalation & Incident Management: Leading the CX response to local incidents and handling high-tier German customer escalations with empathy, local market context, and sound judgment. Resource & Capacity Coordination: Partnering with vendor management on workload forecasting and planning to ensure efficient agent coverage during high-volume promotional periods in Germany. Cross-Departmental Initiatives: Representing the CX function in broader business initiatives to champion a seamless, end-to-end experience for the German audience. 🫵 About You Customer Operations Experience: Solid experience managing customer service or customer experience teams. Vendor Management Experience: Experience managing or working closely with outsourced support partners at scale, with a focus on building strong relationships and driving partner performance. German Market & Channel Expertise: Fluent in German (or deep experience managing support for the German/DACH region) with hands-on experience across multiple support channels (email, voice, and live chat). Metrics & Data-Driven: Confident working with performance metrics (CSAT, FTR, SLAs) and using data to drive decisions and coach partner teams. Cross-Functional Collaborator: A clear and confident communicator who collaborates effectively across internal teams (Product, Marketing, Delivery) and acts as the connective tissue with external partners. jobs.title: Process Manager ITSM ITIL & Service Catalog
jobs.description: Process Manager ITSM – ITIL & Service Catalog Location: Huddinge / Stockholm, Sweden Working Arrangement: Hybrid / Partial Remote Job Type: Consultant Reference Number: UPP-2026/118 Assignment Period: 15 November 2026 – 31 December 2027, with a possibility of extension until 31 December 2029 Scope: Approximately 20% (8 hours per week) Application Deadline: 27 October 2026 About the Assignment We are looking for an experienced ITSM Process Manager to provide specialist expertise, advisory support, and quality assurance for IT service management initiatives. The assignment focuses on developing a structured service catalog and defining service management principles aligned with ITIL/ITSM best practices and organizational requirements. You will collaborate with project teams, business representatives, IT specialists, and architects to translate business needs into clear functional requirements for an ITSM platform. The role also involves facilitating workshops, identifying risks and dependencies, and ensuring that service catalog design aligns with broader service and support processes. Key Responsibilities Develop and quality-assure service models and principles for structuring a service catalog. Support service catalog design based on ITIL/ITSM best practices and business needs. Identify, document, and validate functional requirements for an ITSM platform. Ensure alignment between service catalog requirements and Service & Support processes. Facilitate workshops with business representatives, IT teams, architects, and project stakeholders. Provide recommendations based on industry best practices and previous ITSM implementations. Identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and alternative approaches. Define service catalog structures, service levels, categorization, relationships, attributes, and governing principles. Support requirements development and quality assurance throughout the project lifecycle. Mandatory Requirements Very good written and spoken Swedish. At least 7 years of experience in ITIL/ITSM. At least 3 years of experience working with service catalogs related to ITIL/ITSM. At least 3 years of experience translating ITIL/ITSM frameworks into practical working methods. At least 3 years of experience developing and quality-assuring functional requirements for ITSM platforms based on business needs, processes, and desired working methods. At least 3 years of experience implementing and/or procuring ITSM platforms and service catalogs within larger organizations. Preferred Qualifications Excellent workshop facilitation skills and the ability to structure discussions with business, IT, architecture, project management, and specialist teams. Good understanding of Service Request Management, Incident Management, and related ITSM processes. Ability to challenge assumptions, identify gaps and dependencies, and ensure the quality of requirements and proposed solutions. Experience defining service catalog structures, service levels, categorization, relationships, attributes, and governance principles. Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to submit an updated CV highlighting their ITSM/ITIL experience, service catalog development, functional requirements management, and ITSM platform implementation or procurement experience. Please clearly specify the duration of experience for each mandatory requirement. Application deadline: 27 October 2026.

In this position, you will work closely with customers in the process industry, develop long-term relationships, and identify new service opportunities that improve plant reliability, safety, and performance. You will be an important part of our Nordic service organization, helping customers get the most out of their installed valve base while contributing to the continued growth of our service business. Flexible location within Sweden, preferably in Northern Sweden. Your responsibilities You will drive service sales activities across Sweden, with a primary focus on customers in the northern parts of the country. You will build and maintain strong relationships with existing and new customers, identifying opportunities to support their reliability and performance goals. You will collaborate closely with our service organization and authorized service partners to expand our service presence and strengthen customer support. You will promote and sell maintenance, repair, and operational services, as well as develop opportunities for long-term service agreements. You will act as a trusted partner to customers, understanding their business needs and translating them into value-adding service solutions. Expectations for you You have a technical background within the process industry. You are customer-focused and skilled at building long-term customer relationships and identifying business opportunities. Experience in valve technology, flow control solutions, or the process industry is considered an advantage. You hold a valid driver’s license. You communicate confidently in Swedish and English. Willingness and ability to travel and actively visit customers. To succeed in this role To succeed, you need a strong understanding of industrial service business and the ability to create trust-based customer relationships. You combine commercial drive with technical curiosity and enjoy spending time close to customers to understand their challenges and future plans. Experience from valves, maintenance services, or process industries will help you identify opportunities where our services can improve reliability, safety, and operational performance. The team works closely with customers throughout the lifecycle of their equipment, developing service solutions that maximize plant uptime and performance. A key part of the strategy is expanding local service presence and building strong customer relationships through dedicated teams and a network of service partners. This is an opportunity to have a real impact on the growth of the service business while working in a customer-focused and international environment.
